_provenance: English for abilities of units restored from Japan's data with hand-written text (Kira, source/exvius/restore_kira.py) that the kira-event pack left without English (player report 2026-11-12: Kira's skill shows no name in battle). Found by walking every ability his unit, LB, Trust/Super Trust rewards and their abilities refer to (HANDOFF 2026-11-12). Variants keep their base ability's name (Japan names them the same); 1442000-1442020 are named as Sword King's Command upgrades (+1..+3, the Vacuum Fang pattern; Japan's own description reads 'Test Data'). Served by ios_texts (F_TEXT_ABILITY_NAME, F_TEXT_ABILITY_EXPLAIN_SHORT) and ios_tables (F_ABILITY_EXPLAIN_MST), only where the shipped text is missing or Japanese.
